tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: Search or filter the layout catalog to find a specific layout. Returns metadata only, no HTML. Also the tool for "what is new", "any new layouts?", "what got added since last month" - pass `since` and it returns only what landed after that date. tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Search or filter the theme catalog. Returns metadata and key colors only, not the full CSS.

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Return one layout as a ready-to-use, self-contained document: HTML, theme CSS, and its slot definitions. Call this once the user knows which layout they want, or with ids returned by suggest_deck.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Return one theme in full: its complete CSS and design tokens.

tools.name: get_starter_kit
tools.description: Call this when joining several fetched layouts into one deck file. Requests like "merge these into one file", "bundle it as a deck", or "make it one HTML" mean this tool. Returns the base CSS, assembly rules, spacing tokens, and a viewport snippet for standalone viewing.

tools.name: suggest_deck
tools.description: Compose a deck and return a preview link the user can open in the browser right away. The user sees what the finished deck looks like without a single file being generated. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "suggest_deck" is 1317 chars, far longer than this server's median (234). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "suggest_deck" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
